items.title: Solana’s rent reform could free 3.08M SOL – But is it really an ‘airdrop’?
items.whyYouShouldCare: The proposed rent reform could release 3.08 million SOL into circulation, potentially impacting liquidity and user engagement within the Solana ecosystem.

items.title: Hidden Solana upgrade bug can freeze network readers and silently disable fee limits
items.whyYouShouldCare: A bug in a Solana upgrade poses risks by potentially freezing network readers and affecting fee limits, which could disrupt transaction efficiency and user confidence.

items.title: How to Reclaim Excess SOL After Rent Reduction
items.whyYouShouldCare: Guidance on reclaiming excess SOL post-rent reduction highlights the importance of understanding new protocols for optimizing asset management within the Solana network.
